title: When you should not use a disposable email address
excerpt: Banking, government, healthcare, employers, and anything with account recovery need a durable address. Here is exactly how the expiring-inbox failure plays out.
meta_title: When not to use disposable email | TempMail Central
meta_description: Why banking, healthcare, employers, and any account you plan to keep need a durable address: a password reset sent to an expired inbox is gone forever.
